messages:
Sasha: quick check — noticed tiny high-priority requests are getting queued behind big batches after the cb heuristics PR (#452). can someone confirm?
Evan: saw the same in staging yesterday. p99 small-req latency spiked ~50ms during a tiny-burst run.
Sasha: repro steps i used:
```bash
loadgen --profile tiny-burst --qps 1000 --prio high \
  --max_batch_tokens 4096 --batch_window_ms 12
```
logs show repeated lines: `priority_fairness: deprioritized due to smoothing_weight=0.8`
Evan: can you paste the exact log fragment?
Sasha: sure — snippet:
```
[2026-04-03 15:12:11] cb_scheduler INFO: queued_batch size=78 tokens=3200 pri=low
[2026-04-03 15:12:11] cb_scheduler WARN: priority_fairness: deprioritized request_id=abc123 pri=high smoothed=0.78
[2026-04-03 15:12:11] cb_scheduler DEBUG: batch_dispatch latency_ms=7
```
Judy: is this from the smoothing change in cb-priority-smoothing PR? iirc weight was increased to 0.8 to reduce churn.
Marc: pinging for quick coordination. @Tia can you run a tiny-priority sigtest on staging with priority_smoothing=0.4 and preemptive_eviction=true? need results for throughput/p95.
Tia: starting run now: job id loadgen:tiny-prio-171650, target 1k qps, 20m. ETA ~22m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Runtime CI: job loadgen:tiny-prio-171650 completed. summary: p95_small=78ms (baseline 66ms) p99_small=154ms (baseline 132ms). link: https://ci.internal/jobs/171650
Evan: results look marginally better after lowering smoothing, but p99 still up. maybe max_batch_tokens for low-prio is too high.
Judy: suggestion: cap low-prio max_batch_tokens=512, and allow preemptive_eviction for high-prio if window<16ms. config patch:
```yaml
cb:
  priority_smoothing: 0.4
  preemptive_eviction: true
  max_batch_tokens_per_priority:
    high: 512
    low: 4096
```
Sasha: also requesting a quick code review: small change in cb_scheduler.py to honor preemptive_eviction. file & line ~120. @Marc can you take a look? i can open a tiny PR.
Marc: will review in ~30m, assigning to myself. if blocked we should revert smoothing change and do a controlled rollout.
Tia: attached quick CSV from the run (p50/p95/p99) and a flamegraph link: https://perf.internal/flame/171650
Sasha: thanks. if Marc approves we can merge config and run a scheduled canary (5% traffic) then promote. otherwise revert :thumbsup:
Marc: LGTM on the small fix, added one nit. merging rollback of smoothing param for immediate safety and will follow up with gradual rollout this afternoon.
Evan: followup: can we add a microbench in perf CI that exercises tiny-priority path daily? caught this earlier.
Runtime CI: created perf job template `perf/tiny-priority` and scheduled daily run at 03:30 UTC.
Sasha: great — i'll add a short doc in the PR describing the alert rule we want for priority starvation and the sigtest steps. thanks all :rocket:
